955 BF — Peach's Castle.description: Highsun 1, 955 BF, Peach's Castle — the past selves (actors/peachs-castle-955) and the generated 955 BF versions of the cast, filed under their factions: the court under Mushroom Regency & Kingdom, the incursion under Koopa Troop.

entries.name: Dr. Toad
entries.look: A Star Hill doctor who treated Luigi's burns after the lava-falls rescue, diagnosed pain-and-exhaustion delirium, and prescribed clean dressings, fluids, rest, and no adventuring. Waluigi remains suspicious of the name but not the treatment. Dr. Toad is, according to Dr. Toad, actually named Dr. Toad. Waluigi asked because somebody had to. The doctor treated Luigi's arm and leg burns as serious but survivable, identified confusion and trauma signs without forcing the Mario question open, and left the room quickly once he understood that the word brother was now a surgical instrument. entries.name: Luigi
entries.look: Luigi is the reluctant ghostbuster, the brother left behind by every heroic story that needed Mario in front, and the man whose history now carries the unresolved shadow of Mr. L, Guild contracts, haunted technology, medical testimony, and a disappearance mystery too large to fit inside the word sidekick. Waluigi finds Luigi infuriating, sympathetic, suspicious, brave, evasive, and extremely bad at choosing restful employment. The Poltergust is not just a vacuum; it is Luigi’s proof that fear can be weaponized into duty. The Garden Above the Fire confirms that Luigi survived the lava-falls aft

entries.name: Mario
entries.look: Mario is—or WAS—the most famous hero in the Mushroom Kingdom. The man who saved Princess Peach countless times before her assassination in 955 BF. The red-capped plumber who could jump higher than physics should allow, who stomped Bowser's schemes into the ground repeatedly, who was so synonymous with heroism that his NAME became a verb. And then, after eighty-five years of diminished appearances and growing silence, he DISAPPEARED entirely. Luigi found him at the Star Fountain. They flew together on wing caps. entries.name: Mages' Guild Adept (Hooded)
entries.look: Era sheet: Highsun 1, 955 BF, Peach's Castle. Art and stats describe this figure on the night of the Day Of (events.json highsun_1_955_bf_the_day_of ), not the present day of the campaign (1040 BF). Violet hooded robe with silver sigils, crystal-topped staff, scroll satchel. The record says two hooded Mages' Guild mages conferred with Mayor Thornpaw tonight. Whose side they are on is the GM's call; this sheet works for a loyal court magician and for a conspirator. Alternate tokens: portraits/peachs-castle-955/court-mage-b.png , portraits/peachs-castle-955/court-mage-c.png .

entries.name: Princess Peach (955 BF)
entries.look: Era sheet: Highsun 1, 955 BF, Peach's Castle. Art and stats describe this figure on the night of the Day Of (events.json highsun_1_955_bf_the_day_of ), not the present day of the campaign (1040 BF). The reigning monarch of the Mushroom Kingdom, alive and holding court. Pink gown, golden crown, white gloves, sapphire brooch, parasol. The XP ledger ( data/abilityPoints.json ) carries her at level 4, so this sheet sits at CR 2: a sovereign, not a duelist. entries.name: Toadsworth the Elder, Royal Chamberlain (955 BF)
entries.look: Era sheet: Highsun 1, 955 BF, Peach's Castle. Art and stats describe this figure on the night of the Day Of (events.json highsun_1_955_bf_the_day_of ), not the present day of the campaign (1040 BF). Royal Chamberlain for more than thirty years. Beige spotted cap, spectacles, white moustache, charcoal cloak with brooch over a purple waistcoat and bow tie; cane and pocket watch. Level 4 in the XP ledger ( toadsworth_sr ), so CR 1 — he wins rooms, not fights. After the Day Of he becomes Acting Regent; he dies around 1020 BF and his journals are disputed.
